nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report less shine through the day, a more balanced and brighter complexion, and visibly smaller pores; one young reviewer with oily skin, however, found no noticeable benefit overall.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who identifies as having dry skin reports no irritation and a refreshing feel, but no noticeable tightening effect, and found the results underwhelming.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including combination-oily, report smaller-looking pores, a calmer and more balanced complexion, and easy layering with actives like vitamin C without pilling or irritation.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report no irritation and a soothing, calming effect, and several specifically credit the fragrance-free formula for this.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 50s who describe their skin as mature report firmer, more toned, less congested skin and reduced redness with continued use.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers in their 40s and 50s, describing their skin as mature, report firmer, more toned, less congested skin with continued use. One reviewer in her 20s or 30s reports no noticeable improvement in wrinkles specifically and speculates the plumping effect may suit older or drier skin more than her own.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers broadly report the lightweight, watery texture hydrates without stripping or leaving a tight feeling, including in cold, dry winter conditions; no reviewer in this set reports the product itself causing dryness.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with reactive or flare-prone skin, including some dealing with hormonal acne or sunscreen irritation, report the ampoule calms redness quickly and consistently; no dissent on this point appears in the set.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer, in her 50s, reports the ampoule works on her skin barrier rather than just masking redness, describing her mature skin as looking better than it has in years.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports no visible improvement in spots after use; another, who has sun-induced spots, reports her overall complexion looking brighter without singling out the spots themselves.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who describe themselves as acne- or clog-prone, report no new breakouts and calmer, less congested skin, with some noting clearer pores and fewer blackheads specifically. One reviewer (3 stars), however, reports the product broke her out badly, which she attributes to her skin possibly not tolerating the concentration of centella used.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report less shine through the day, a more balanced T-zone, and a brighter complexion; one reviewer with oily skin reports no noticeable benefit overall.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup without pilling
No noticeable pore-size change for some

I recently received a free sample of the Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Fresh Ampoule through the BzzAgent sampling program. I used the Poreminimizing Fresh Ampoule for 2 weeks, and unfortunately, didn't see much of a difference in my skin. I could see this product working for someone with older, more wrinkly, or dehydrated skin, as it does a good job of plumping up the skin. But as a young person without many wrinkles and very oily skin, I didn't receive many benefits from using it. I liked that it had very little to no fragrance and didn't irritate my skin, though.

I'm in my 50's and have tried just about everything out there. Most products I've found just cover up redness but this one works on your skin barrier to heal it from within. I'm using it day and night and my mature skin has never looked better…wish i'd found Madagascar Centella Poremizing Ampule sooner! Will definitely repurchase.

extraits.titre: Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule – First Impressions Review
extraits.texte: I'm 37 with combination, mature skin that deals with redness and hormonal acne, so I'm careful about what I introduce into my routine. I started using the Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule after receiving it through a promotional offer, and I'm genuinely glad I gave it a try. I've been using it a few times a week, worked into my normal routine on the days I'm not using stronger actives. The texture is lightweight and refreshing, and it absorbs quickly without any tackiness. One of the biggest wins for me is how easily it layers—I've been able to use it alongside my vitamin C and peptide serums with zero pilling or irritation. My skin often flares with redness, but this ampoule feels calming the moment it goes on. Over time, I've noticed my skin looking more balanced and less congested, and the areas where my pores tend to appear larger look smoother and more refined. It hasn't triggered breakouts, which is always a concern for my hormonal acne. Even though it's still relatively new to my lineup, it has become a product I genuinely look forward to using. It leaves my skin feeling calm, fresh, and subtly more polished. I'm excited to see how the benefits continue to build with ongoing use.
